outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches its handle and raises the door through frames 61–78 (image and left_ego_image), bringing it upright against the oven front. The door remains closed through frame 279 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt, damage, or disturbance of unrelated tabletop objects is visibly established; the subsequent stationary hold does not undo the completed task.
